newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch manufacturers expect big rise in investment.
newsitem.headline: Dutch manufacturers expect big rise in investment.

text.p: Dutch manufacturers expect their investment in fixed assets to rise by some 28 percent in 1997 in guilder terms compared with 1996, the Central Bureau of Statistics (CBS) said on Friday.
The CBS said its latest twice-yearly poll of manufacturers' investment plans showed they expected to invest some 19 billion guilders this year.
The overall figure is swollen by the oil-refining sector which expects investment to rise roughly sixfold to around 3.5 billion guilders.
Investment excluding the oil sector is expected to rise by about eight percent, the CBS said.
Manufacturers' expectations do not always tally with actual investment spending.
In May 1995 manufacturers told the CBS they expected their investments to rise by 30 percent, but in fact investment outlays for the year rose by only 12 percent.
In May 1996, however, they predicted an increase of six percent while actual spending rose some seven percent.
